name: Docker Logs
description: Docker Compose inside Orca: discover root and nested configs, detect running stacks, resolve .env profiles, and inspect containers, live logs, stats and errors with Ask agent.

cover.alt: Docker Logs in Orca: effective and running profiles, container health, resource usage, ports, log search and a collapsed Python traceback

screenshots.alt: Current Docker Logs panel in dark mode showing Compose profiles, six services, container health, CPU, memory, ports and searchable API logs
screenshots.caption: Profiles, container health, resource stats, ports and searchable logs. Demonstration data.

screenshots.alt: Current Docker Logs panel with the same container, profile and log controls in a light theme
screenshots.caption: The same tools in a light theme: container state, resource usage, live logs and Ask agent. Demonstration data.

screenshots.alt: Two current panels comparing all services' merged logs with the same logs filtered to warnings and errors
screenshots.caption: Merged service logs beside warnings and errors, with saved views. Demonstration data.

screenshots.alt: Compose settings showing nested base and override files, a nested environment file, inherited web and jobs profiles and enabled services
screenshots.caption: Ordered nested configs and environment profiles, previewed before Apply. Demonstration data.

screenshots.alt: Detected Compose stack picker with a custom project name, running-service profile memberships and verified existing containers
screenshots.caption: Detect running stacks from nested configs and review settings before Apply. Demonstration data.

settings.title: Docker CLI path
settings.description: Absolute path to the docker binary. Leave empty to find it on PATH, in /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin or Docker Desktop.

settings.title: Agent for “Ask agent”
settings.description: Agent Orca starts with the log when you press Ask agent, such as claude or codex.

settings.title: Notify when a container fails
settings.description: Desktop notification when a container of the focused project crashes, keeps restarting or turns unhealthy.
